name: servos
description: Read-only access to your SERVOS organization's guests, orders, stays, service bookings, tickets and reports.

interface.longDescription:
SERVOS is the operations platform for experiential hospitality – accommodation, dining, spa, events, classes and retail in one system. Connect it to ask about your own organization in plain language.

What you can do:
• Find any guest, order, stay, booking or ticket by name, email, phone, order number or confirmation code
• Open an order with its items, payments and what is still owed, or a stay with its dates, room and guests
• See who is arriving, departing or in-house on a given day, and which sauna sessions, classes and other services are booked
• Owners and admins can run reports on occupancy, rates, revenue, room nights, sales, payments, customers and event capacity – over any period and by channel, room type or product – drawn as charts and tables in the conversation

Access is read-only: nothing can be created, changed or deleted. You sign in with your SERVOS account, choose which organization to connect, and see only what your role allows. Guests' names, emails and phone numbers are shared only when an owner or admin turns this on while connecting; otherwise guests appear only by an id.

Requires a SERVOS account.
capabilities: Search guests, orders, stays, bookings and tickets
Read orders, stays, bookings, tickets and customers
List today's arrivals, departures and service bookings
Run occupancy, revenue and sales reports
defaultPrompt: Who is arriving and departing today?
Show me the orders placed this week.
Chart our occupancy and room revenue this month by room type.

positive.description: List the stays on a given day
positive.prompt: Who arrived and who was staying with us on 2 November 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the stays arriving on and covering 2 November 2026 in the demo organization: three arrivals (rooms 102, 201 and 202) and four stays in house that night, with their rooms and confirmation codes. Cancelled stays are left out.

positive.description: List and open the service bookings on a given day
positive.prompt: Which sauna sessions and classes were booked on 2 November 2026? Open the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the service bookings starting on 2 November 2026, earliest first, with their times and services, then opens the first booking with its details. Cancelled bookings are left out.

positive.description: List orders in a period and open one
positive.prompt: Show me the orders placed on 1 and 2 November 2026, then open the largest one and tell me what's still owed.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the orders placed on 1–2 November 2026, newest first, then opens the largest with its items, payments, totals and outstanding balance.

positive.description: Search and open a stay and its customer
positive.prompt: Find the stay in room 201 that arrived on 2 November 2026, show its details and tell me about that customer.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the room 201 stay, returns its dates, room, guests and order, then opens the customer with their stay and order counts and recent stays.

positive.prompt: Chart occupancy and room revenue per night for November 2026, split by room type.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the report guide, writes a SERVOS QL query and runs it. Returns nightly occupancy and room revenue for November 2026 by room type, rendered as an interactive chart in the conversation.

negative.description: Cancel a booking (writes are not supported)

negative.prompt: Refund the newest order in full.
Show me today's arrivals at a different hotel that isn't the one I connected.

review.commerce_description: SERVOS does not sell anything in ChatGPT. All tools are read-only and no payments are processed.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search, orders, stays, service bookings, tickets, customers, and occupancy and revenue reports with an interactive chart view. Read-only.
